messages:
Samir: Quick roundup from the KV-cache OOM postmortem 1: we need owners, backups, and explicit abort criteria for the soft-limit rollout.
Anya: I'll own profiling and RCA. Plan: 2 snapshots per shard (low/high churn), diff, flamegraphs. ETA Fri.
Javier: I'll own the soft_limit change + per-model prefix_warmer toggle. Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m windows. Abort if p95 latency +20ms or evictions >2x.
Priya: I'll add telemetry: fragmentation_ratio and kv_residency_bytes per-model. Alert if fragmentation delta > 12% for 10m.
Maya: I'll own the emergency reclaim job (slab_compact). Toggle requires 2 approvers; safety: abort if CPU > 70%. ETA 48h.
Samir: Backups: Kai for Maya, Kai for Anya profiling infra, Priya for Javier rollback. Document owners in the postmortem checklist.
Anya: Commands I'll run:
```
kv_snapshot --shard=$S --out=/tmp/kv-$S.snap
kv_diff /tmp/kv-*.snap > /artifacts/diff.txt
```
Artifacts -> s3://redwood-oom/postmortem-2201234567/.
Javier: Config snippet:
```
shard_defaults: { soft_limit_ratio: 0.75, eviction_policy: lru_aggressive }
models: { heavy-churn: { prefix_warmer: { enabled: false } } }
```
Priya: Runbook short: trigger -> fragmentation >12% OR evictions/sec >150 for 10m; steps -> disable warmers top3 models, throttle writers 10%, run slab_compact if needed, escalate after 30m.
Maya: slab_compact job will be idempotent and run per-shard; requires two approvers via the UI toggle.
Samir: Deadlines recap: profiling (Anya) by Fri EOD, canary config (Javier) tomorrow morning, alerts/dashboard (Priya) Thu EOD, slab_compact (Maya) 48h.
Anya: Hypothesis: prefix warmers hold transient refs preventing slab compaction; will include stack traces and candidate fixes (weak refs).
Javier: I'll add rollback automation to the canary pipeline to revert config and notify oncall if abort criteria hit.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder created: "KV OOM followups check-in" 2026-03-26 10:00 UTC attendees: eng-runtime.
Priya: I'll add a synthetic test that churns prefixes and measures fragmentation; run nightly in staging for a week before full rollout.
Samir: Thanks. If anything slips, create a blocker in the postmortem doc and page me. We'll run the first follow-up next week. :thumbsup:
